description: Use for yes/no on specific part numbers x specific models, e.g. "does 01FR025 or 01AV489 fit my T490 and T495?". To list every model a part fits use get_part_fits; for a model's parts use get_model_parts. Give part_number, part_numbers or both (merged, duplicates dropped); at most 100 part x model pairs, else an error result. Parts match as in get_part; models resolve like get_model_parts, once each. One part keeps the single-part shape: results in model order; an unknown part is an error result. Several parts add parts (input order, each with its own results and fits_count) and make results a flat list in part then model order, with part_query and part_number on each row: a side-by-side comparison. An unknown or ambiguous part there is flagged in its entry (status not_found or ambiguous) and its rows have fits null. Each row: fits true with constraints, source_url, confidence; fits false with fit_status no_documented_fit (no document, not incompatibility); fits null for an ambiguous or unknown model. Read-only.

client.description: Optional: your agent or app name (letters and digits), used only for anonymous usage counts.

models.description: Required. 1 to 20 model slugs or full names, e.g. ["lenovo-thinkpad-t490", "ThinkPad T495"].

part_number.description: One OEM part number, with or without dashes or spaces, e.g. "01FR025" or "7K4PW". Give this, part_numbers, or both.

part_numbers.description: Several OEM part numbers to compare, e.g. ["01FR025", "01AV489", "L78555-005"]. Merged after part_number; parts x models must be at most 100.

name: check_part_fits

display_name.description: Short human label; not an identifier

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

title: Check a part against models
